title: A Cargo application with no Oyzu configuration
expected: Select Cargo from native metadata, build a binary and collect test results.
Retain native JUnit and measured application coverage alongside snapshot artifacts.

cases.name: failed-test
cases.expect: Tests fail; report collection never reports success.

cases.name: feature-gated-binary
cases.change: Use variants/features.Cargo.toml and variants/extra.rs, then enable and disable the native extra default feature.
cases.expect: Only enabled binaries appear in the artifact plan and final bundle, with native executable identity and snapshot versions.

cases.name: failed-compilation
cases.change: Introduce a compiler error after a successful build.
cases.expect: Compilation fails and previous executable outputs never become artifacts of the failed build.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
